issues.description: Field 'orders' in SealSaloon: the problem statement and UML require a modifiable List<Meal> named 'orders', but the provided starter utilities and the reference solution use a Meal[] array for orders (and ArrayHelpers only provides array-based helpers). This creates a type mismatch: students are told to implement a List but the codebase and helpers assume arrays, causing confusion about which collection type to use and which helper methods to call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type for 'orders' consistent across specification, starter code, helpers, and tests. Either: (A) Update the problem statement and UML to specify an array-based orders field (Meal[]) and explicitly mention ArrayHelpers as the intended utility; or (B) Replace array usage with List<Meal> throughout the template and solution, provide corresponding List-based helper code (or use java.util.List directly), and update the UML and instructions to require List<Meal>. Ensure the exercise text clearly states which collection type students should use.
